headline: Don Toliver brought new music from “Nitrous” to Paris He kicked off the international leg
body: Don Toliver brought new music from “Nitrous” to Paris He kicked off the international leg of his Octane World Tour with a crazy crowd, giving fans a preview of his upcoming project along the way. Hearing unreleased music live adds a whole different level of anticipation, and Paris got a taste of what Don has coming next. With the international run underway, fans have even more reason to keep an eye on his setlists. How’s the new music sounding? Y’all ready for “Nitrous”?
